import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r"([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*(?:"
    r"\(\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100"
    r"|(\d+))"
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    target, source, increment, literal = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100

order = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in order) + ";")
